name: mabl
description_en:
mabl provides automated testing across browser, mobile and API workflows, with local tools, self-hosted CI execution and a managed cloud. These execution paths differ in orchestration, diagnostics and resource use; they are not equivalent ways to obtain every platform capability.

This profile focuses on choosing an execution path, reviewing auto-heals and retries, and estimating the current Core-plan usage model. It also records the retirement of an older agentic recovery feature so marketing language does not substitute for current operating behavior. No app, account, test, credential, network agent or billed run was operated.
description_zh:
mabl 提供浏览器、移动及 API 自动测试，包含本地工具、自托管 CI 执行及托管云。各路径在编排、诊断及资源使用方面不同，不能视作获得全部能力的等价方式。

本文聚焦执行路径选择、自动修复／重试审查及当前 Core 用量模型，也记录较早 Agent 恢复功能退役，避免用营销表述替代现行行为。本次未操作应用、账户、测试、凭据、网络 Agent 或计费运行。

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_en: Local smoke checks omit cloud orchestration and artifacts
sections.title_zh: 本地 smoke 检查不含云编排及产物
sections.en: The execution matrix lists local and CI Runner as sequential, Chrome-only browser paths without cloud artifacts or full plan orchestration. Cloud provides richer diagnostics, cross-browser execution and parallelism, but its published customer limits are finite, including one thousand concurrent browser tests. Local pass/fail feedback cannot establish that the same scenario succeeded on every target browser. Select a path for each test’s purpose rather than assuming the pricing page’s unlimited wording removes operating limits.
sections.zh: 执行矩阵将本地及 CI Runner 列为顺序、仅 Chrome 浏览器路径，不含云产物或完整计划编排。云提供更多诊断、跨浏览器及并行，但公开客户上限有限，例如浏览器测试一千并发。本地通过／失败反馈不证明全部目标浏览器成功。应按测试用途选路径，不把价格页无限表述当作取消运行上限。

sections.title_en: A local plan grouping is not a cloud plan run
sections.title_zh: 本地计划分组不等于云计划运行
sections.en: The plan guide says local execution from a plan ID does not support cloud stages, shared variables, concurrency, DataTable scenarios or credential overrides. Rerunning only failed tests can also fail when it omits successful setup tests on which they depended. Design independent checks or explicitly retain their setup chain. A smaller rerun is useful only when it reconstructs the state the failed check expects.
sections.zh: 计划指南说明，本地按计划 ID 执行不支持云阶段、共享变量、并发、DataTable 场景或凭据覆写。只重跑失败测试也可能因省略依赖的成功设置步骤而再次失败。应设计独立检查或明确保留设置链，只有能重建预期状态时，更小的重跑才有意义。

sections.title_en: An auto-healed locator can still target the wrong element
sections.title_zh: 自动修复的定位仍可能指错元素
sections.en: mabl exposes auto-heal insights, screenshots, element history and a Find Summary for passing plan runs that healed. The guide explicitly includes fixing incorrect matches by rolling back/editing history or retraining a step, and disabling auto-heal per step. Review whether the assertion still checks the intended behavior after a UI change; a healed passing run is not independent evidence that the locator was correct.
sections.zh: mabl 为自动修复后通过的计划运行提供洞察、截图、元素历史及 Find Summary。指南明确包含用历史回退／编辑或重新训练步骤纠正错误匹配，并可逐步禁用自动修复。界面变化后需检查断言仍验证预期行为，修复后通过不独立证明定位正确。

sections.title_en: The previous agentic runtime recovery was retired
sections.title_zh: 此前 Agent 运行恢复已退役
sections.en: The runtime-recovery article says the agent-based feature was switched off in all workspaces on August 3, 2026. Its historical description should not be treated as an active capability just because pricing still lists agentic runtime recovery. The successor is a specific page refresh and retry mechanism, not an agent choosing arbitrary corrective actions. Confirm the current plan settings and release when evaluating a recovery promise.
sections.zh: 运行恢复文章称 Agent 功能已在 2026 年 8 月 3 日于全部工作区关闭。即使价格页仍列 agentic runtime recovery，也不应将历史说明当作现行能力。后继是特定页面刷新重试机制，不是 Agent 自选修正动作。评估恢复承诺时应确认当前计划设置及发布。

sections.title_en: A refresh retry changes page state and result semantics
sections.title_zh: 刷新重试改变页面状态及结果语义
sections.en: Runtime Recovery Refresh is off by default and applies to configured cloud browser plans. It reloads and retries a supported step once; modes either allow a recovered pass or retain a failed test at the end. Ad hoc/local runs and listed unsupported step types do not use it. Reloading discards unsaved page state, so compare initial and refreshed artifacts before trusting a recovery. This successor does not use an LLM.
sections.zh: Runtime Recovery Refresh 默认关闭，用于已配置云浏览器计划，对受支持步骤刷新并重试一次；模式可允许恢复通过，或最终仍保留测试失败。单次／本地运行及所列不支持步骤不采用。刷新丢弃未保存页面状态，信任恢复前应比较初次及刷新后产物。后继机制不使用 LLM。

sections.title_en: Core credits and user activity are different billing inputs
sections.title_zh: Core 信用额度及用户活动是不同计费输入
sections.en: The Core usage guide prices cloud test types differently and counts authoring activity separately from workspace permissions. It describes annual credit allocation without rollover, unlike the pricing FAQ’s monthly starting allowance. Local mabl runs use zero credits; local Playwright visual assertions have a separate charge row, so free-local wording cannot be generalized to every integration. Confirm the actual contract and user classification rather than deriving a bill from run count alone.
sections.zh: Core 用量指南对云测试类型采用不同额度，并将编写活动与工作区权限分开计算。其年度额度不结转，与价格 FAQ 的每月起始额度说法不同。本地 mabl 运行不耗信用，但本地 Playwright 视觉断言另有收费行，因此免费本地不能泛化到全部集成。需核实际合同及用户分类，不能仅按运行次数推算账单。

sections.title_en: Allocation guidance becomes a stop only when enforced
sections.title_zh: 额度指引只有强制启用后才成为停止条件
sections.en: Company admins can enforce a workspace credit allocation; enforcement is off by default. The guide says usage can lag by about ten minutes, allowing extra runs and billable overage past a limit. Treat this as delayed resource control rather than an exact zero-overage guarantee. Local/CI runs are outside that cloud stop. Review allocation changes after adding workspaces so the available budget still matches the intended test coverage.
sections.zh: 公司管理员可强制工作区额度，默认不启用。指南称用量可能约十分钟延迟，超过限额后仍可能启动额外运行并产生超额费用。因此它是延迟资源控制，不保证精确零超额；本地／CI 不受该云停止条件影响。新增工作区后应检查分配，使预算仍对应预期覆盖。

sections.title_en: A cloud run still needs a route to the target
sections.title_zh: 云运行仍需能访问目标的路径
sections.en: Public applications are reached directly; private targets can use mabl Link and supported network configuration. The network guide distinguishes the desktop/Trainer browser and proxy requirements from a continuously running Link agent. Browser analytics identification headers do not apply to all API/mobile traffic. Verify the intended path and data handling in a controlled environment; this research did not change a firewall, install a tunnel or expose an application.
sections.zh: 公开应用可直接访问，私有目标可用 mabl Link 及受支持网络配置。网络指南区分桌面／Trainer 浏览器、代理要求及需持续运行的 Link Agent；浏览器分析标识头不适用于全部 API／移动流量。应在受控环境核路径及数据处理，本次未改防火墙、安装隧道或开放应用。
